items.title: Q&A: State Street Goes Live With Custody Offering
items.summary: State Street is now marketing its RIA clearing and custody business, targeting larger RIAs, and plans to go live with an anchor client in the U.S. in the next couple of months, says John Plansky, head of State Street Wealth Services.

items.title: Is State Street Corporation Stock Outperforming the S&P 500?
items.summary: State Street Corporation has outpaced the S&P 500 Index over the past year, and analysts remain somewhat bullish about the stock’s growth prospects.

items.title: The $16.4 trillion ETF market hit a record that tells two stories
items.summary: A wave of new fund launches masks how investors are positioning their money.

items.title: Better Artificial Intelligence ETF: Roundhill's CHAT vs. State Street's XLK
items.summary: Roundhill's AI-focused fund delivered 55.2% returns but carries higher volatility and fees. State Street's broader tech ETF offers lower costs and steadier performance for long-term investors.

items.title: Better Healthcare ETF: Vanguard's VHT vs. State Street's Pharmaceuticals-Focused XPH
items.summary: Vanguard's broader healthcare portfolio charges less and yields more, but State Street's pharma-focused fund has delivered stronger recent gains despite higher volatility.

items.title: Which Healthcare ETF Is the Better Buy: Fidelity's Broad FHLC or State Street's Pharma-Focused XPH?
items.summary: FHLC captures the whole healthcare opportunity at rock-bottom cost. XPH narrows the bet to pharmaceuticals and charges significantly more for it.

items.title: 10 Investment Must Reads for This Week (Sept. 8, 2026)
items.summary: Some investors are letting AI agents do their investing, but skeptics worry about the risks. State Street and UC Investments have launched an “endowment inspired” ETF. These are among the investment must reads for financial advisors this week.
